units.source_text: 龟山公园里数松树最多，所以看不见季节色彩的变化。

en.t: Kameyama Park has mostly pine trees, so the changes in the colors of the seasons cannot be seen.

units.source_text: 这是一座高低起伏的大公园，松树树干停停而立，没有树叶，光秃秃的，无计其数不规则地交错着。

en.t: It is a large park with rising and falling ground, where bare, leafless pine trunks stand upright and countless others crisscross irregularly.

units.source_text: 人们眺望公园的远近，便产生一种不安的感觉。

en.t: When people gaze across the park, near and far, they begin to feel a certain unease.
